title: Windows: Quit from tray — three-layer exit guarantee
highlights: Windows: Quit from tray now exits reliably — three layers of guarantee. Layer 1: a 500 ms kill thread starts directly inside the MenuFlyoutItem click handler, independent of Application.Current or any WinUI state. Layer 2: App.RequestQuit() now uses a static App._instance reference instead of Application.Current as App, which silently returned null when the window was hidden. Layer 3: QuitEntanglo() starts a 2 s raw-Thread watchdog before touching any service — even if cleanup blocks, the process exits.
Windows: installer no longer gets stuck when upgrading over a running build. PrepareToInstall runs taskkill /F before any file is copied.
